Class AllPlainEnvironmentEndpointFilter

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.controlpanel.panels.management.AllPlainEnvironmentEndpointFilter
All Implemented Interfaces:
io.micronaut.management.endpoint.env.EnvironmentEndpointFilter
@Singleton @Requires(property="micronaut.control-panel.env.show-values",value="true",defaultValue="false") @Requires(classes=io.micronaut.management.endpoint.env.EnvironmentEndpointFilter.class) @Requires(condition=ControlPanelEnabledCondition.class) public class AllPlainEnvironmentEndpointFilter extends Object implements io.micronaut.management.endpoint.env.EnvironmentEndpointFilter
Built-in environment endpoint filter that can be enabled via configuration to display actual configuration values with legacy masking (masking only sensitive keys like passwords). This filter can be enabled by setting the configuration property: micronaut.control-panel.env.show-values=true
Since:
1.8.1
Author:
Álvaro Sánchez-Mariscal
